models.title: Deferred tax liability from an asset taxable temporary difference
models.summary: The reading multiplies an asset taxable temporary difference by the applicable tax rate.

relationship.original_equation: Deferred tax liability = (asset carrying amount - tax base) × applicable tax rate
relationship.locator: Paragraphs 15, 24–25 and 47; examples of taxable and deductible differences
relationship.translation_notes: This is an undiscounted liability from one asset; the positive taxable difference is carrying amount less tax base.

models.title: Deferred tax asset from an asset deductible temporary difference
models.summary: An asset tax base above its carrying amount gives a deductible temporary difference subject to recognition conditions.

models.title: Reported effective income-tax rate
models.summary: The reported effective tax rate is tax expense divided by pretax accounting income.

relationship.original_equation: Reported effective tax rate = income tax expense / pretax accounting income
relationship.translation_notes: Currency cancels and the result is a base-one ratio. The public filing excludes equity in earnings of operating joint ventures from its denominator, a disclosure-specific scope.
